name: apex-conformance-local
description: Executable smoke and dry-run checks for APEX Protocol alpha implementations

scripts.verify:alpha: npm run go-http-account-state && node scripts/smoke.mjs typescript && node scripts/smoke.mjs go && node scripts/smoke.mjs rust && node scripts/smoke.mjs java && node scripts/dry-run.mjs typescript && node scripts/dry-run.mjs go && node scripts/dry-run.mjs rust && node scripts/dry-run.mjs java
scripts.verify:production: npm run production-replay && node scripts/production-smoke.mjs typescript && node scripts/production-smoke.mjs go && node scripts/production-smoke.mjs rust && node scripts/production-smoke.mjs java && node scripts/production-resilience.mjs typescript && node scripts/production-resilience.mjs go && node scripts/production-resilience.mjs rust && node scripts/production-resilience.mjs java
scripts.verify:transport: npm run session-cleanup && npm run cleanup-timeout && npm run typescript-http-reuse && node scripts/transport-smoke.mjs typescript && node scripts/transport-smoke.mjs go && node scripts/transport-smoke.mjs rust && node scripts/transport-smoke.mjs java && node scripts/transport-resilience.mjs typescript && node scripts/transport-resilience.mjs go && node scripts/transport-resilience.mjs rust && node scripts/transport-resilience.mjs java && node scripts/transport-marketdata.mjs typescript && node scripts/transport-marketdata.mjs go && node scripts/transport-marketdata.mjs rust && node scripts/transport-marketdata.mjs java
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:alpha && npm run verify:production && npm run verify:transport
